mapper.select: SELECT owner_id,session_id,question_id,answer_id,early_feedback,granted_at FROM ai_evaluation_access WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND question_id=#{questionId} AND answer_id=#{answerId}
SELECT owner_id,task_id,session_id,question_id,answer_id,created_at FROM ai_evaluation WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_evaluation WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND answer_id=#{answerId}
SELECT id,feedback_id,revision,choice,reason,created_at FROM ai_feedback_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY feedback_id,revision

SELECT q.id AS question_id,q.title,q.status,q.answer_count,q.latest_answer_id, COUNT(t.id) AS task_count,COALESCE(SUM(t.status='SUCCEEDED'),0) AS completed_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','VALIDATING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')),0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.status IN ('FAILED','UNKNOWN','CANCELED')),0) AS failed_count FROM training_question q LEFT JOIN ai_evaluation e ON e.owner_id=q.owner_id AND e.session_id=q.session_id AND e.question_id=q.id AND e.answer_id=q.latest_answer_id LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=e.owner_id AND t.id=e.task_id WHERE q.owner_id=#{owner} AND q.session_id=#{sessionId} GROUP BY q.id,q.title,q.status,q.answer_count,q.latest_answer_id,q.position_index ORDER BY q.position_index
